author: Unity
description:
Bring your own creations into Unity Studio! In this tutorial, you’ll learn how to import assets, from simple 3D models to complex CAD files, using the integrated Asset Manager powered by Unity. 

Unity Studio is a web-based, no-code editor designed for industries like manufacturing, automotive, healthcare, architecture, and more to build and share interactive 3D applications fast. Import CAD, BIM, or 3D data and bring ideas to life in minutes.

For assistance or questions, please check out our documentation for helpful articles and guides:
https://on.unity.com/StudioImportAssets

If you still need help, contact our support team at: 
unitystudio-support@unity3d.com
title: Unity Studio – Importing Assets
